content.introduction: On October 7, 2026, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's Economic Indicators Calendar lists several key economic data releases. The notable events include the Producer Price Index (PPI) and NAR Existing Home Sales at 10:00 AM, Advance Retail SalesPDF, Empire State Manufacturing Survey, Imports and Exports, Initial Claims, Philadelphia Fed Manufacturing Survey, Business InventoriesPDF, Reserve Demand Elasticity, and Weekly Economic Index at 8:30 AM, and Business Leaders Survey and Industrial Production at 8:30 AM. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for all events listed on this date.

Economic Indicators Calendar

Provides the date and time of key economic data releases (all Eastern Time). New York Fed content is available at or shortly after the scheduled times indicated. When available, links on the calendar direct you straight to the data source (often OFFSITE).
